column2: PRECEDENT: an existing guard explicitly argues against this exact step
column4: HIGH-SIGNAL, not a mismatch but a documented objection. The guard's own rationale for exempting RuleCategory.php from its \"no literal rule-name copy outside the owning capability\" rule reads: \"...deriving the group label from a producer name would make the name space's spelling a behavioural contract again -- the exact thing that [RuleCategory's own] docblock records having removed.\" This sentence describes -- and rejects -- precisely the planned step. Whoever wrote this test considered and declined first-segment derivation for RuleCategory specifically. This does not mean the step is wrong, but the plan must explicitly re-open and address this argument, not silently override it.
